card.name: Second digit of citation numbers
card.fires_on: A digit inside a bracketed or parenthetical reference number, usually the second digit after a leading 1 (as in 12, 13, 14). It appears in scientific citations at the end of a claim.

modes.label: Second digit of reference
modes.description: The final digit of a two-digit citation number in parentheses after a claim.
